# NEW 2026-11-21 v8.0 Module 4, Russian Empire Early Modern Line (1600-1800, oe_rem_, slot 60). Generated by gen_rus_early_modern.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Country scope. Increment traditionalist unrest safely (clamped 0..100).
oe_rem_add_trad_unrest = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_rem_trad_unrest } change_variable = { name = oe_rem_trad_unrest add = $amt$ } }
    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_rem_trad_unrest value = $amt$ } }
    clamp_variable = { name = oe_rem_trad_unrest min = 0 max = 100 }
}

# Country scope. Apply bilateral opinion modifier with live c:ROM or c:BYZ.
oe_rem_apply_new_rome_bias = {
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:ROM c:ROM = { is_rebel_country = no } NOT = { tag = ROM } }
        add_opinion = { modifier = $bias$ target = c:ROM }
        c:ROM = { add_opinion = { modifier = $bias$ target = root } }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:BYZ c:BYZ = { is_rebel_country = no } NOT = { tag = BYZ } }
        add_opinion = { modifier = $bias$ target = c:BYZ }
        c:BYZ = { add_opinion = { modifier = $bias$ target = root } }
    }
}

# Country scope. Apply shared bilateral country modifier on live c:ROM or c:BYZ.
oe_rem_apply_new_rome_mod = {
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:ROM c:ROM = { is_rebel_country = no } NOT = { tag = ROM } }
        c:ROM = { add_country_modifier = { modifier = $mod$ years = $yrs$ mode = replace } }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:BYZ c:BYZ = { is_rebel_country = no } NOT = { tag = BYZ } }
        c:BYZ = { add_country_modifier = { modifier = $mod$ years = $yrs$ mode = replace } }
    }
}

# Country scope. Apply Baltic rivalry alarm (-40 opinion) to Sweden, Poland, and Poland-Lithuania.
oe_rem_apply_baltic_alarm = {
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:SWE NOT = { tag = SWE } } c:SWE = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_rem_b_baltic_alarm target = root } } }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:PLC NOT = { tag = PLC } } c:PLC = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_rem_b_baltic_alarm target = root } } }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:POL NOT = { tag = POL } } c:POL = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_rem_b_baltic_alarm target = root } } }
}

}

# Country scope. Bilateral Treaty of Kyakhta with Restored Mongol Yuan (c:CHI): opinion, partner modifier & Chao trust.
oe_rem_kyakhta_yuan_compact = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_rem_yuan_stands = yes NOT = { tag = CHI } }
        add_opinion = { modifier = oe_rem_b_kyakhta_yuan_treaty target = c:CHI }
        c:CHI = {
            add_opinion = { modifier = oe_rem_b_kyakhta_yuan_treaty target = root }
            add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_rem_kyakhta_yuan_partner years = 35 mode = replace }
            oe_yc_add_trust = { amount = 8 }
        }
    }
}

# Country scope. Upgrade Baltic port (neva > oreshek > narva > riga > tallinn > arkhangelsk > capital).
oe_rem_upgrade_baltic_port = {
    if = { limit = { owns = location:neva } location:neva = { add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_rem_neva_admiralty_loc years = 40 mode = replace } } }
    else_if = { limit = { owns = location:oreshek } location:oreshek = { add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_rem_neva_admiralty_loc years = 40 mode = replace } } }
    else_if = { limit = { owns = location:narva } location:narva = { add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_rem_neva_admiralty_loc years = 40 mode = replace } } }
    else_if = { limit = { owns = location:riga } location:riga = { add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_rem_neva_admiralty_loc years = 40 mode = replace } } }
    else_if = { limit = { owns = location:tallinn } location:tallinn = { add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_rem_neva_admiralty_loc years = 40 mode = replace } } }
    else_if = { limit = { owns = location:arkhangelsk } location:arkhangelsk = { add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_rem_neva_admiralty_loc years = 40 mode = replace } } }
    else_if = { limit = { exists = capital } capital = { add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_rem_neva_admiralty_loc years = 40 mode = replace } } }
}

# Country scope. Bind resolved host cleanly without overwriting Phase 1/2 variables.
oe_rem_bind_host = {
    save_scope_as = oe_rem_tmp_host
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_rem_host value = scope:oe_rem_tmp_host }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_rem_trad_unrest } } set_variable = { name = oe_rem_trad_unrest value = 0 } }
}

# Any scope. Resolve live Rus' Early Modern host: c:RUS > Phase 2/1 human Rus' > East Slavic owner of moscow/novgorod/kyiv > MOS/NOV/KIE/TVE.
# Every location owner access checks has_owner = yes first.
oe_rem_resolve_host = {
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:RUS c:RUS = { is_rebel_country = no } }
        c:RUS = { oe_rem_bind_host = yes }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { oe_rp2_has_live_player = yes global_var:oe_rp2_player = { is_rebel_country = no oe_rus_country = yes } }
        global_var:oe_rp2_player = { oe_rem_bind_host = yes }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { oe_rpl_has_live_player = yes global_var:oe_rpl_player = { is_rebel_country = no oe_rus_country = yes } }
        global_var:oe_rpl_player = { oe_rem_bind_host = yes }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { location:moscow = { has_owner = yes owner = { is_rebel_country = no oe_rus_country = yes } } }
        location:moscow = { owner = { oe_rem_bind_host = yes } }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { location:novgorod = { has_owner = yes owner = { is_rebel_country = no oe_rus_country = yes } } }
        location:novgorod = { owner = { oe_rem_bind_host = yes } }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { location:kyiv = { has_owner = yes owner = { is_rebel_country = no oe_rus_country = yes } } }
        location:kyiv = { owner = { oe_rem_bind_host = yes } }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:MOS c:MOS = { is_rebel_country = no } }
        c:MOS = { oe_rem_bind_host = yes }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:NOV c:NOV = { is_rebel_country = no } }
        c:NOV = { oe_rem_bind_host = yes }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:KIE c:KIE = { is_rebel_country = no } }
        c:KIE = { oe_rem_bind_host = yes }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:TVE c:TVE = { is_rebel_country = no } }
        c:TVE = { oe_rem_bind_host = yes }
    }
}

# Any scope. One-time initialization (post-1600).
oe_rem_init_line = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_rem_init value = 1 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_rem_end value = 0 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_rem_sent_cnt value = 0 }
    oe_rem_resolve_host = yes
    if = {
        limit = { oe_rem_has_live_host = yes }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_rem_on value = 1 }
    }
    else = {
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_rem_end value = 8 }
    }
}

# Country scope (resolved Rus' host). Expire closed windows & dispatch at most one event per calendar month.
oe_rem_dispatch_events = {
    if = { limit = { current_year > 1655 trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_rem_fired_1 } NOT = { global_var:oe_rem_fired_1 = 1 } } trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_rem_fired_1 } NOT = { global_var:oe_rem_fired_1 = 2 } } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_rem_fired_1 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { current_year > 1675 trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_rem_fired_2 } NOT = { global_var:oe_rem_fired_2 = 1 } } trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_rem_fired_2 } NOT = { global_var:oe_rem_fired_2 = 2 } } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_rem_fired_2 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { current_year > 1695 trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_rem_fired_3 } NOT = { global_var:oe_rem_fired_3 = 1 } } trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_rem_fired_3 } NOT = { global_var:oe_rem_fired_3 = 2 } } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_rem_fired_3 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { current_year > 1735 trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_rem_fired_4 } NOT = { global_var:oe_rem_fired_4 = 1 } } trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_rem_fired_4 } NOT = { global_var:oe_rem_fired_4 = 2 } } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_rem_fired_4 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { current_year > 1745 trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_rem_fired_5 } NOT = { global_var:oe_rem_fired_5 = 1 } } trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_rem_fired_5 } NOT = { global_var:oe_rem_fired_5 = 2 } } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_rem_fired_5 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { current_year > 1765 trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_rem_fired_6 } NOT = { global_var:oe_rem_fired_6 = 1 } } trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_rem_fired_6 } NOT = { global_var:oe_rem_fired_6 = 2 } } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_rem_fired_6 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { current_year > 1780 trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_rem_fired_7 } NOT = { global_var:oe_rem_fired_7 = 1 } } trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_rem_fired_7 } NOT = { global_var:oe_rem_fired_7 = 2 } } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_rem_fired_7 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { current_year > 1750 trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_rem_fired_8 } NOT = { global_var:oe_rem_fired_8 = 1 } } trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_rem_fired_8 } NOT = { global_var:oe_rem_fired_8 = 2 } } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_rem_fired_8 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { current_year > 1775 trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_rem_fired_9 } NOT = { global_var:oe_rem_fired_9 = 1 } } trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_rem_fired_9 } NOT = { global_var:oe_rem_fired_9 = 2 } } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_rem_fired_9 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { current_year > 1800 trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_rem_fired_10 } NOT = { global_var:oe_rem_fired_10 = 1 } } trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_rem_fired_10 } NOT = { global_var:oe_rem_fired_10 = 2 } } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_rem_fired_10 value = 2 } }
    if = {
        limit = { trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_rem_ev_m } NOT = { global_var:oe_rem_ev_m = global_var:oe_rem_m } } }
        if = {
            limit = { oe_rem_open_1 = yes }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_rem_fired_1 value = 1 }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_rem_ev_m value = global_var:oe_rem_m }

            else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_rem_sent_cnt value = 1 } }

            limit = { oe_rem_open_2 = yes }

# Public monthly entry point (scheduler slot 60 AND oe_rem_pulse.txt fallback).
# Strictly idempotent per calendar month via oe_rem_ran_m.
oe_rem_monthly = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_rem_m value = oe_rem_m_now }
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_rem_done }
            OR = { has_global_variable = oe_rem_on current_year >= 1600 }
            trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_rem_ran_m } NOT = { global_var:oe_rem_ran_m = global_var:oe_rem_m } }
        }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_rem_ran_m value = global_var:oe_rem_m }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_rem_init } }
            oe_rem_init_line = yes
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = {
                has_global_variable = oe_rem_end
                trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_rem_end } global_var:oe_rem_end = 8 }
                current_year <= 1805
            }
            oe_rem_resolve_host = yes
            if = {
                limit = { oe_rem_has_live_host = yes }
                set_global_variable = { name = oe_rem_end value = 0 }
                set_global_variable = { name = oe_rem_on value = 1 }
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { has_global_variable = oe_rem_on }
            if = {
                limit = { current_year > 1805 }
                set_global_variable = { name = oe_rem_end value = 3 }
                set_global_variable = { name = oe_rem_done value = 2 }
                remove_global_variable = oe_rem_on
            }
            else = {
                # Re-bind seamlessly if RUS was formed mid-line or prior host fell.
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        OR = {
                            NOT = { oe_rem_has_live_host = yes }
                            AND = { country_exists = c:RUS c:RUS = { is_rebel_country = no } NOT = { global_var:oe_rem_host = c:RUS } }
                        }
                    }
                    oe_rem_resolve_host = yes
                }
                if = {
                    limit = { oe_rem_has_live_host = yes }
                    global_var:oe_rem_host = { oe_rem_dispatch_events = yes }
                }
                else = {
                    set_global_variable = { name = oe_rem_end value = 8 }
                    remove_global_variable = oe_rem_on
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

oe_rem_job_11 = {
        set_variable = { name = oe_rem_dynasty_path value = 1 }
        add_gold = -100
        add_legitimacy = 12
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_rp2_phase2_done trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_rp2_phase2_done } var:oe_rp2_phase2_done = 1 } } add_stability = 4 }
        add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_rem_romanov_autocracy years = 30 mode = replace }
}

oe_rem_test_start = {
    oe_rem_test_clear = yes
    oe_rem_bind_host = yes
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_rem_init value = 1 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_rem_on value = 1 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_rem_end value = 0 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_rem_sent_cnt value = 0 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_rem_m value = oe_rem_m_now }
}

oe_rem_test_month = {
    remove_global_variable = oe_rem_ran_m
    oe_rem_monthly = yes
}

oe_rem_test_peter = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_rem_on } } oe_rem_test_start = yes }
    set_variable = { name = oe_rem_westernization value = 1 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_rem_peter_reform value = 1 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_rem_peter_reform value = 1 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_rem_trad_unrest value = 60 }
    add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_rem_petrine_westernization years = 35 mode = replace }
}

    location:neva = { change_location_owner = root }
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_rem.6
}
